; codex authored frames (dummy content, no real screens), codex-cli 0.159.2 shapes. `paint.py codex.txt <id>` paints one;
; `capture.py` regenerates observations.jsonl from both corpora; frames_test.go replays it. grammar:
; docs/terminal-observation-codex.md. frames ending -default-footer or n12/n60 have no run-state word (idle from the screen).
; header: #frame <id> <W>x<H> alt=<0|1> [obs=bottom.first=<row>,clipped] expect=<activity>/<interaction>/<notice>/<composer>
;         reason=<reason> rules=<id>[@top|@compound],...|none (the classifier's decision order; regions default to bottom).
; obs=... drops the rows above <row> from the bottom region and marks it clipped, as a byte cap would.
; rows:   NN|<text with tags> (NNN| from row 100); unlisted rows are blank; every row starts from the default style.
; tags: {b}1 {d}2 {i}3 {u}4 {r}7 {br}1;7 {bd}1;2 {/}0 {/fg}39 {red}38;5;1 {grn}38;5;2 {yel}38;5;3 {mag}38;5;5
;       {cyan}38;5;6 {acc}38;2;99;168;248 {run}38;2;200;169;238 {mdl}38;2;246;226;183 {dir}38;2;171;223;167
;       {gly}1;38;2;128;128;128 {ora}38;2;255;178;66 {key}38;2;64;64;64 {sec}38;2;115;115;115 {run2}38;2;131;64;218
;       {mdl2}38;2;156;105;35 {hl}1;38;2;0;0;46;48;2;164;205;251 {pbg}48;2;240;240;240 {lgly}1;38;2;32;32;32
;       {lhdr}38;2;141;141;141 {lacc}38;2;28;100;200 {warn}38;2;196;167;103 {fill}=EL (erase to end of row in the current background)
;       {osc:URL}/{/osc}=OSC 8 open/close.

#frame <id> <W>x<H> alt=<0|1> [obs=bottom.first=<row>,clipped] expect=<activity>/<interaction>/<notice>/<composer> reason=<reason> rules=<id>[@top|@compound],...|none
; rows:   NN|<text with tags> (NNN| from row 100); unlisted rows are blank; every row starts from the default style.
; rules are listed in byte order (the classifier emits them in decision order, so compare sorted lists); rule regions
; default to bottom. obs=... describes the PaneObservation the classifier receives (rows above <row> dropped by the byte
; cap, Clipped set); painting alone does not reproduce it.
; tags: {b}1 {d}2 {i}3 {u}4 {r}7 {br}1;7 {bd}1;2 {/}0 {/fg}39 {red}38;5;1 {grn}38;5;2 {yel}38;5;3 {mag}38;5;5
;       {cyan}38;5;6 {acc}38;2;99;168;248 {run}38;2;200;169;238 {mdl}38;2;246;226;183 {dir}38;2;171;223;167
;       {gly}1;38;2;128;128;128 {ora}38;2;255;178;66 {key}38;2;64;64;64 {sec}38;2;115;115;115 {run2}38;2;131;64;218
;       {mdl2}38;2;156;105;35 {hl}1;38;2;0;0;46;48;2;164;205;251 {pbg}48;2;240;240;240 {lgly}1;38;2;32;32;32
;       {lhdr}38;2;141;141;141 {lacc}38;2;28;100;200 {warn}38;2;196;167;103 {fill}=EL (erase to end of row in the current background)
;       {osc:URL}/{/osc}=OSC 8 open/close.
